office until such time as, in the case of the Individual Trustees, a Trustee resigns, or is removed, or dies, or becomes incapable of acting or is adjudged as bankrupt or insolvent. Whenever there
shall be a vacancy in the office of an Individual Trustee, a successor shall be appointed by the holders of a majority in interest of the Units then outstanding.
